Who We Are

More than one thing.
Never halfway.

"We don't build companies to sell a product. We build them because something needed to exist and nobody else was going to do it right."

KD Supply, Limited is a private holding company based in Cardington, Ohio. Founded by Kian Dart-Snouffer, we operate across automotive services, SaaS software, and lifestyle and apparel — not because diversification is a strategy, but because these are the things we know how to do and care about doing well.

Every venture under the KD Supply umbrella is owner-operated, built with real capital discipline, and designed to grow into something lasting. We are not venture-backed. We are not chasing trends. We are building.

The Founder

Kian
Dart-Snouffer

Kian Dart-Snouffer is a mechanic, entrepreneur, and founder based in central Ohio. He left the typical 8–6 employment world in 2025 to build KD Supply, Limited full time — starting with a wrench in his hand and a clear idea of the world he wanted to build.

His background spans flat rate automotive work, B2B sales, real estate, environmental science, and software — a combination that doesn't often travel together, and that informs everything he builds. He believes the most durable businesses are built by people who actually understand the problem they're solving.

He is the operator, not just the owner. The person answering the phone at Liberty Garage Works is the same person who wrote the first line of code in ShopSynq, designed the first KD Supply tee, and is scoping the next strategy move. That's intentional.

How We Operate

The principles
we don't compromise on.

01
Owner on the floor.

Every business we operate is run by someone who can do the work, not just manage people who do. That's not a policy — it's how we're built.

02
No fake, no hollow.

We don't build things to look impressive. We build things that work, that last, and that we'd use ourselves. Authenticity isn't a brand value. It's a minimum requirement.

03
Speed to revenue.

We don't chase funding rounds. We build things that serve our customers, reinvest disciplined capital, and grow from the inside out. Impact is the point.
